about: Story-themed covers for Hindi-section books on booknomics.com that had no cover_url (live catalogue checked 2026-10-09). Artwork is AI-generated without any text; title, author and the BOOKNOMICS wordmark are set by tools/cover-studio/compose.mjs so every Devanagari spelling matches the database exactly.

books.title: गोदान
books.author: मुंशी प्रेमचंद
books.palette: bright mustard yellow, soft sky blue, warm cream
books.concept: Rural Uttar Pradesh in the 1930s, from Premchand's novel Godan: Hori, a lean, sun-weathered farmer in his fifties with grey stubble, in a coarse off-white dhoti, worn kurta and faded turban, gently strokes the forehead of a white zebu cow with a brass bell; his wife Dhaniya, in a faded red-bordered cotton sari pulled over her head, stands beside him with a tired, tender smile; mud-walled thatched hut and a field of blooming yellow mustard in soft early-morning haze.

books.title: बंधन
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: pearl-white river mist, pale dawn gold, soft slate blue
books.concept: Ancient India, from Narendra Kohli's Mahasamar (the Mahabharata retold), part one: at dawn the young prince Devavrat — tall, broad-shouldered, clean-shaven, long black hair tied back, bare-chested in a white dhoti with gold armlets — stands waist-deep in the misty Ganga and raises his right hand in his lifelong vow, his face resolute; on the bank the grey-bearded fisherman chief Dashraj watches, and the young fisher-maiden Satyavati sits in a wooden boat in the mist.
books.note: Made in the earlier classic layout; to be redone in the site summary style.

books.title: अधिकार
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: fresh leaf green, morning sunlight gold, soft forest haze
books.concept: Ancient Hastinapur, from Narendra Kohli's Mahasamar, part two: in a sunlit forest training ground Guru Drona, a stern grey-bearded Brahmin teacher in white with a sacred thread, stands behind the young prince Arjuna, who draws his bow and aims at a small wooden bird high in a tree, utterly focused; the other young princes in simple dhotis watch, and Duryodhana, proud and heavy-browed, glares with jealousy.
books.note: Made in the earlier classic layout; to be redone in the site summary style.

books.title: कर्म
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: royal crimson, marigold, torchlight gold, deep shadow
books.concept: Ancient Panchal, from Narendra Kohli's Mahasamar, part three: Draupadi's swayamvar in a vast torch-lit pillared hall — Arjuna, disguised as a poor young Brahmin with a sacred thread and tied-up hair, draws the giant bow, aiming upward while looking down at the reflection of a revolving target in a bronze basin of oil; behind him the dusky, striking princess Draupadi, in a crimson and gold silk sari, holds a marigold garland; rows of astonished kings in the shadows.
books.note: Made in the earlier classic layout; to be redone in the site summary style.

books.title: धर्म
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: deep royal purple, tarnished bronze, flickering lamp amber
books.concept: The royal hall of Hastinapur, from Narendra Kohli's Mahasamar, part four: the game of dice — Yudhishthira, a dignified bearded king in a white and gold uttariya, stares in anguish at ivory dice on an embroidered board; across from him Shakuni, a lean, sharp-featured older man with a thin grey beard and a sly smile, rolls the dice; Duryodhana lounges on a carved throne behind, smirking; Bhima's clenched fist in the foreground; flickering oil lamps and heavy purple drapes.
books.note: Made in the earlier classic layout; to be redone in the site summary style.

books.title: अंतराल
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: monsoon slate grey, deep teal green, small warm firelight
books.concept: Forest exile, from Narendra Kohli's Mahasamar, part five: the five Pandava brothers and Draupadi, in coarse bark-cloth and faded cotton, outside a thatched hut deep in a rain-soaked forest during the monsoon; Draupadi, her hair loose and unbound, tends a small fire under the eaves with a resolute face; the burly Bhima and the calm Yudhishthira stand at the edge of the veranda looking out into the misty forest; streaks of rain, wet leaves.
books.note: Made in the earlier classic layout; to be redone in the site summary style.

books.title: प्रच्छन्न
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: rose-pink sandstone, ivory sunlight, soft indigo
books.concept: King Virata's palace, from Narendra Kohli's Mahasamar, part six: the year in disguise — Draupadi, living as the maid Sairandhri in a plain indigo cotton sari with no jewellery, braids the long hair of Queen Sudeshna in a sunlit courtyard of rose-pink sandstone arches; in the background Arjuna, disguised as Brihannala, a dance teacher with long braided hair and bangles, teaches a young princess.
books.qa: AI art had a flat title band with a hard edge at y=286; softened with seam.
books.note: Made in the earlier classic layout; to be redone in the site summary style.

books.title: प्रत्यक्ष
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: sapphire blue, white marble, morning gold light
books.concept: The assembly hall of Hastinapur, from Narendra Kohli's Mahasamar, part seven: Krishna's peace mission — Krishna, a dark-skinned man with a calm face, a peacock feather in his hair and yellow silk garments, stands in the centre of a white marble court and speaks with quiet authority; the blind old king Dhritarashtra listens from his throne, the white-bearded Bhishma and Guru Drona sit gravely, and Duryodhana rises in anger; shafts of morning light fall from high windows.
books.note: Made in the earlier classic layout; to be redone in the site summary style.

books.title: निर्बन्ध
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: fiery orange sun, black smoke, dusty ochre
books.concept: Kurukshetra, from Narendra Kohli's Mahasamar, part eight: the war begins — on a war chariot drawn by four white horses, Krishna, the charioteer, youthful and clean-shaven with no beard or moustache, dark-skinned, with a peacock feather in his hair and yellow silk garments, turns from the reins to speak gently to Arjuna, who has sunk down with his great bow lowered, overcome with grief; two vast armies with banners and spears stretch across the dusty plain under a fiery orange sun and drifting black smoke.
books.note: First render showed Krishna with a beard; redo with a youthful, clean-shaven Krishna.

books.title: आनुषंगिक
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: smoky lavender dusk, ash grey, faint ember red
books.concept: After the great war, from Narendra Kohli's Mahasamar, part nine: at dusk the blindfolded queen Gandhari, an elderly woman in a plain white sari with a strip of cloth over her eyes, is gently guided by Kunti, also in white, across the silent, smoke-veiled plain of Kurukshetra; behind them women in white carry small clay oil lamps; a broken chariot wheel and torn banners lie in the dust; Krishna, youthful and clean-shaven, stands quietly at a distance with his head bowed. Calm, grieving and dignified.
books.note: Bed-of-arrows scene was blocked by the image moderation; use the mourning scene instead.

books.title: दीक्षा
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: sacred-fire saffron, indigo pre-dawn blue, forest shadow
books.concept: A forest hermitage, from Narendra Kohli's Ram-katha Abhyuday, part one (Deeksha): before dawn the sage Vishwamitra — lean and ascetic, with long grey matted hair and beard, in saffron robes — initiates the teenage princes Ram and Lakshman, who kneel before a sacred fire with bows across their laps, eyes closed in concentration; sparks rise into the dark; tall sal trees all around.
books.note: Made in the earlier classic layout; to be redone in the site summary style.

books.title: अवसर
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: olive green, warm amber afternoon light, earthy brown
books.concept: Chitrakoot forest, from Narendra Kohli's Ram-katha Abhyuday, part two (Avsar): in a sunlit forest clearing outside a simple leaf hut, Bharat, a young prince in plain mourning white, kneels with tears in his eyes and holds up a pair of wooden sandals; Ram, youthful and clean-shaven, calm, in simple bark-cloth garments with his hair tied up, places his hands on Bharat's shoulders; Sita and Lakshman stand behind them; elders and soldiers from Ayodhya watch.

books.title: युद्ध
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: storm steel blue, black clouds, molten gold firelight
books.concept: The seashore facing Lanka, from Narendra Kohli's Ram-katha Abhyuday, part four (Yuddh): at dusk Ram, a determined, youthful, clean-shaven warrior prince with his hair tied up and a great bow in his hand, stands on wet sand at the edge of the sea with Lakshman beside him and an army of forest-tribe warriors with spears and torches behind them; across the dark water the golden fortress city of Lanka glows under a stormy sky.

books.title: अभ्युदय
books.author: नरेन्द्र कोहली
books.palette: coral sunrise, misty turquoise river, deep blue dawn sky
books.concept: The Ganga at sunrise, from Narendra Kohli's Ram-katha Abhyuday: the boatman Guha, a strong, weathered tribal chief, rows a long wooden boat across the wide river; in it sit Ram and Lakshman, youthful and clean-shaven, in simple ochre bark-cloth garments with their bows, and Sita in a plain ochre cotton sari, looking back toward the shore; mist on the water, a coral sun rising.

books.title: काबुलीवाला
books.author: रवींद्रनाथ ठाकुर
books.palette: deep twilight blue, indigo, warm lamp gold
books.concept: Calcutta in the 1890s, from Tagore's story Kabuliwala: Rahmat, a tall Afghan dry-fruit seller in his forties with a thick dark beard, large grey turban, long kurta, worn embroidered waistcoat and a heavy cloth sack, crouches on the worn stone steps of an old house and holds out raisins and almonds to Mini, a five-year-old Bengali girl in a cotton frock who smiles shyly; carved wooden door, peeling lime-washed walls, a lit gas lamp, narrow lane at blue hour.

books.title: क्षुधित पाषाण
books.author: रवींद्रनाथ ठाकुर
books.palette: moonlit marble white, deep emerald-black water, faded rose
books.concept: The Deccan in the 1890s, from Tagore's story Kshudhit Pashan (The Hungry Stones): late at night a young tax collector in a white kurta and dhoti stands spellbound on the moonlit marble steps of a deserted 250-year-old Mughal palace that descend into the river Susta; around him, half-seen in the river mist like a memory, faint figures of veiled women in Persian silks seem to drift down the steps; rose petals on the wet marble.

books.title: घरे-बाइरे
books.author: रवींद्रनाथ ठाकुर
books.palette: vermilion red, crimson, ember orange, deep night
books.concept: Bengal in 1905, from Tagore's novel Ghare-Baire: Bimala, a young Bengali woman in a red-bordered white silk sari with sindoor and conch-shell and red lac bangles, stands at a tall barred wooden window of an old zamindar mansion at night, her face lit by firelight, torn and uncertain; behind her in a dim lamp-lit room her husband Nikhilesh reads quietly; outside, softly out of focus, a crowd around a bonfire of foreign cloth, sparks rising.

books.title: पथेर पाँचाली
books.author: बिभूतिभूषण बंद्योपाध्याय
books.palette: silvery white kash flowers, soft grey sky, muted monsoon green, almost black-and-white
books.concept: Rural Bengal in the 1920s, from Bibhutibhushan Bandyopadhyay's novel Pather Panchali: Apu, a thin six-year-old village boy in a loose white cotton shirt, and his older sister Durga, about twelve, barefoot in a faded cotton sari, run hand in hand through a field of tall white kash flowers towards a distant steam train trailing a long plume of black smoke along the horizon; overcast monsoon sky.

books.title: श्रीकांत
books.author: शरतचंद्र चट्टोपाध्याय
books.palette: ink-black night, deep river blue, ember orange glow
books.concept: Bengal in the early 1900s, from Saratchandra Chattopadhyay's novel Srikant: at night two boys — young Srikant, wide-eyed, and his fearless older friend Indranath, a lean teenager pulling an oar — row a small wooden boat across the dark, wide Ganga; a hanging lantern lights their faces; a cremation pyre glows orange on the distant bank under a thin crescent moon.

books.title: अपने-अपने अजनबी
books.author: अज्ञेय
books.palette: icy blue-white, pale grey, one warm candle
books.concept: A snowbound mountain cabin in Europe in deep winter, from Agyeya's novel Apne-Apne Ajnabi: inside a small whitewashed log cabin, the frail old woman Selma, white-haired and serene, sits wrapped in a wool shawl beside a small iron stove, while the young woman Yoke stands at the frosted window with her arms crossed, restless and afraid; snow piled against the glass, pale winter daylight, a single candle.

books.title: ऐ लड़की
books.author: कृष्णा सोबती
books.palette: warm cream, marigold orange, soft afternoon light
books.concept: A Delhi home in the 1990s, from Krishna Sobti's novel Ae Ladki: a bedridden old mother, frail but fiercely alive, with silver hair, thin gold bangles and a white cotton sari, lies propped on pillows on a white bed and talks with spirit to her middle-aged daughter, who sits beside her holding her hand and listening; sheer white curtains, soft afternoon light, a brass bowl of marigolds on the bedside table.

books.title: चंद्रकांता संतति
books.author: देवकीनंदन खत्री
books.palette: amethyst violet shadows, antique gold lamplight, old stone
books.concept: A hidden tilism beneath an old fort in 19th-century north India, from Devaki Nandan Khatri's Chandrakanta Santati: the young prince Indrajit Singh — handsome, with a thin moustache, in an embroidered angarkha and turban, sword in hand — and a sharp-eyed aiyyar (master spy) holding up an oil lantern discover a massive stone door carved with lotus medallions, coiled serpents and elephant reliefs (ornamental carving only, no letters or script) deep inside a torch-lit underground passage; dust hangs in the lamplight.
books.note: Second render: ornamental carving only, no script. The model left a hard-edged black band at the top of the art; it was feathered into the shadows before composing.

books.title: भूतनाथ
books.author: देवकीनंदन खत्री
books.palette: charcoal black, smoky grey, warm lantern amber
books.concept: A ruined hill fort at night in 19th-century north India, from Devaki Nandan Khatri's Bhootnath: Gadadhar Singh, the legendary aiyyar later called Bhootnath — a middle-aged man with piercing eyes, a thick moustache and a weathered face, wrapped in a dark shawl and turban — steps out of a secret tunnel in a crumbling wall, holding an oil lantern low and glancing back over his shoulder; a cloth bundle of disguises at his belt; moonlit mist over the ramparts.

books.title: काजर की कोठरी
books.author: देवकीनंदन खत्री
books.palette: kohl black, soot grey, bridal red and gold
books.concept: A zamindar's haveli in north India around 1900, from Devaki Nandan Khatri's Kajar ki Kothri: the young bride Sarla, in a red wedding sari with gold jewellery and henna on her hands, sits imprisoned in a dark, soot-blackened room lit only by a thin shaft of light from a high grille, her eyes fierce rather than afraid; through a half-open door behind her, two scheming young men in angarkhas whisper by an oil lamp.

books.title: नरेंद्र-मोहिनी
books.author: देवकीनंदन खत्री
books.palette: soft peach, rose, pearl white, warm golden light
books.concept: A princely estate in Bihar in the 1890s, from Devaki Nandan Khatri's Narendra-Mohini: the young prince Narendra, in a cream angarkha and turban, pauses on a garden path among rose bushes at golden hour, captivated; above him on a carved sandstone balcony the alluring Mohini, in a jewelled peach lehenga, leans on the railing with a knowing smile; half-hidden behind a pillar, Rambha, the gentle girl he was meant to marry, watches sadly.

books.title: वीरेंद्र वीर
books.author: देवकीनंदन खत्री
books.palette: burnished copper sunset, deep shadow, ember red
books.concept: A Rajput hill fort at sunset, from Devaki Nandan Khatri's Virendra Veer: the young warrior Virendra Singh — lean and fierce, with a thin moustache, in a quilted angarkha with a red turban sash flying in the wind — stands on a rocky cliff with his sword drawn, guarding the narrow path to the fort; below, a line of enemy soldiers with flaming torches climbs the slope, and an aiyyar in disguise watches from behind a rock.

books.title: जय यौधेय
books.author: राहुल सांकृत्यायन
books.palette: dusty bronze, pale dawn sky blue, dry grass gold
books.concept: The Yaudheya republic between the Yamuna and the Sutlej, about 350 CE, from Rahul Sankrityayan's Jai Yaudheya: at dawn on a grassy hilltop, the young Yaudheya warrior Jay — strong and sunburnt, in a simple cotton tunic, with a bronze-tipped spear and a round shield — speaks passionately to the gana assembly of elders and armed citizens, men and women seated in a circle on stones; a tribal banner flutters; far across the plains below, dust rises from approaching imperial cavalry.

books.title: सिंह सेनापति
books.author: राहुल सांकृत्यायन
books.palette: terracotta red, ochre, olive green, warm afternoon light
books.concept: Vaishali, the Licchavi republic, about 500 BCE, from Rahul Sankrityayan's Singh Senapati: General Simha — a tall, broad-shouldered commander in his thirties with a short beard — in ancient Indian battle dress: a quilted cotton armour vest over a white dhoti, a cloth headband, copper armlets on bare arms and a straight iron sword at his hip (no Roman or Greek armour); he stands in a terracotta-walled courtyard beside Rohini, a spirited young woman of the republic in a simple ochre garment; behind them citizens gather on the steps of a pillared wooden assembly hall in warm late-afternoon light.
books.note: Second render: ancient Indian battle dress (quilted cotton vest, dhoti, headband), no Roman armour.

books.title: विस्मृत यात्री
books.author: राहुल सांकृत्यायन
books.palette: glacial blue, snow white, ochre robe
books.concept: The Pamir mountains in the 6th century, from Rahul Sankrityayan's Vismrit Yatri: the Indian Buddhist monk Narendrayash — lean, shaven-headed, in a weathered ochre robe, with a wooden staff and a bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts tied to his back — walks a narrow snowy mountain pass beside a small Silk Road caravan of Bactrian camels and fur-clad traders; icy wind, a stone cairn at the edge of the path.

books.title: मधुर स्वप्न
books.author: राहुल सांकृत्यायन
books.palette: turquoise tiles, pomegranate red, dusk indigo, firelight
books.concept: The Sasanian Persian empire in the 6th century, from Rahul Sankrityayan's Madhur Swapna: at dusk in a turquoise-tiled courtyard of a mud-brick Persian town, the wandering hero Shaktavat — a bearded young man in a travel-worn tunic and cloak — shares bread with poor farmers and labourers around a fire; behind them, on a lamp-lit palace terrace, richly dressed nobles and robed priests feast; a crescent moon above.

books.title: अँधेरे के जुगनू
books.author: रांगेय राघव
books.palette: deep night blue-black, firefly yellow-green, faint ember
books.concept: An ancient Indian settlement at night, from Rangeya Raghav's Andhere ke Jugnu: outside a fortified wooden town, enslaved labourers in coarse cloth rest by a dying fire after a day of toil; a young enslaved man with an iron cuff on his wrist and a defiant face looks up as fireflies glow around him; behind a palisade, armed guards with spears and an aristocrat in fine robes watch under torchlight.

books.title: चीवर
books.author: रांगेय राघव
books.palette: desert sand, pale gold haze, ochre robe, unbleached white
books.concept: A small Buddhist monastery in the Vindhya forest, early 7th century CE, from Rangeya Raghav's Cheevar: the young widowed princess Rajyashri — in her early twenties, pale and grief-worn, in a plain unbleached white widow's garment, no jewellery, hair loose — stands on the worn brick steps of the vihara, holding out both hands to receive a folded ochre monk's robe from an elderly shaven-headed Buddhist monk in ochre; beside her, her brother King Harshavardhana — youthful, clean-shaven, in white silk with a pearl necklace and a gold armlet — gently touches her wrist, pleading with her to stay; sal trees, a small whitewashed stupa and hazy golden dust in late-morning light.

books.title: पक्षी और आकाश
books.author: रांगेय राघव
books.palette: clear sky blue, white clouds, whitewashed walls, white pigeons
books.concept: An old crowded family haveli in a north Indian town, 1950s, from Rangeya Raghav's Pakshi aur Akash: Dhankumar — a quiet, thoughtful man in his early thirties in a crumpled white kurta-pyjama — stands alone at the parapet of the sunlit rooftop terrace, looking up as a flock of white pigeons bursts into a vast clear sky; a few steps behind him, at the head of the stairs, his two elder brothers in dhoti and kurta glare at him, one clutching a ring of iron keys, the other pointing at him accusingly; washing lines, clay pots and neighbouring rooftops around them in bright morning light.

books.title: प्रतिदान
books.author: रांगेय राघव
books.palette: rust red dust, dusty brown, low red sun
books.concept: The dusty courtyard of Drona's ashram near Hastinapur, Mahabharata era, from Rangeya Raghav's Pratidan: Dronacharya — a lean, grey-bearded Brahmin teacher in his fifties, in a coarse white dhoti and shawl with a sacred thread, a longbow in his hand, his face stern and unsmiling — stands over King Drupada of Panchala, a proud bearded king in torn royal silks and gold ornaments, kneeling in the dust with his wrists tied by a rope; the young prince Arjuna — youthful, clean-shaven, in a warrior's dhoti with a bow and quiver — stands guard beside them; other young princes and a wooden chariot wait behind in drifting dust under a low red sun.

books.title: टूटे काँटे
books.author: वृंदावनलाल वर्मा
books.palette: plum shadows, rose gold, candlelight, amber smoke
books.concept: A lamp-lit Mughal haveli in Delhi, 1739, from Vrindavanlal Verma's Toote Kaante: Nurbai — a celebrated dancer in her twenties, in a flowing plum-and-rose silk anarkali with gold borders, a sheer dupatta and ghungroo bells at her ankles — pauses mid-turn beneath a cusped marble arch, looking back over her shoulder; beside a pillar stands Mohanlal, a sturdy young Jat villager in a plain white pagri and coarse kurta with a bamboo lathi, watching her with quiet longing; through the arches behind them, smoke from the burning city drifts across an amber evening sky.

books.title: भुवन विक्रम
books.author: वृंदावनलाल वर्मा
books.palette: mint green riverbank, white garments, soft morning daylight
books.concept: A hermitage on the banks of the Sarayu near Ayodhya in the later Vedic age, from Vrindavanlal Verma's Bhuvan Vikram: Prince Bhuvan — youthful, clean-shaven, in his early twenties, in an unstitched white garment with a saffron sash, a plain gold armband and a bow over his shoulder — sits humbly on a reed mat beside a small brick fire altar, learning restraint; Gauri — a graceful young woman in a simple pale cotton garment with jasmine in her braid — stands nearby holding a brass water pot, watching him with a gentle, steady gaze; thatched huts, grazing white cows and the misty river behind them in soft morning light.

books.title: गोली
books.author: आचार्य चतुरसेन शास्त्री
books.concept: A Rajput palace in Rajasthan, early 20th century, from Acharya Chatursen's Goli: Champa — a beautiful palace maid in her early twenties, in a deep maroon-and-gold bandhani ghagra-choli with a veil drawn over her hair and heavy silver anklets — stands by a carved sandstone jharokha window in a lamp-lit palace hall, glancing back over her shoulder with sad, resigned eyes; across the hall, half in shadow by a pillar, Kisun — a young palace servant in a white angarkha and a red safa turban — waits with lowered eyes; behind them a richly cushioned royal gaddi with bolsters and a silver hookah glows in the lamplight.

books.title: सह्याद्रि की चट्टानें
books.author: आचार्य चतुरसेन शास्त्री
books.palette: midnight blue, silver moonlight, black basalt
books.concept: The night assault on Kondhana fort in the Sahyadri hills, February 1670, from Acharya Chatursen's Sahyadri ki Chattanen: Tanaji Malusare — a powerfully built Maratha commander in his forties with a thick curled moustache, in a saffron pheta turban and a white angarkha with a waist sash, a sword at his hip and a round leather shield on his back — climbs a sheer black basalt cliff on a rope, looking up with fierce resolve, while a line of barefoot Mavla soldiers in dhotis and turbans follows him up the rock; the dark ramparts of the hill fort are faint high above under a moonlit sky, and mist fills the valley below.

books.title: चाणक्य
books.author: भगवतीचरण वर्मा
books.concept: The royal court of Pataliputra, Magadha, 4th century BCE, from Bhagwati Charan Verma's Chanakya: Acharya Vishnugupta — a lean, dark-complexioned Brahmin scholar in his forties, clean-shaven, with a shaven head and a single long tuft of hair that he has just untied, in a plain white dhoti and shawl with a sacred thread — stands defiant in the middle of the hall, eyes blazing, as two palace guards in ancient Indian dress (bare-chested, white dhotis, turbans, spears) seize his arms; behind him, on a raised gilded throne, King Dhana Nanda — a heavy, bejewelled king in silks — laughs scornfully among his courtiers; polished stone pillars, brass oil lamps and bottle-green silk hangings.

books.title: अंधेर नगरी
books.author: भारतेंदु हरिश्चंद्र
books.concept: Satirical Indian folk-art scene of a topsy-turvy town: vegetables and sweets on one giant scale, a foolish king on a lopsided throne, an oversized noose on gallows, a plump disciple and his guru.

books.title: भारत दुर्दशा
books.author: भारतेंदु हरिश्चंद्र
books.concept: Ruins of a grand ancient Indian palace overgrown with weeds, a grieving woman in a faded sari on its steps, colonial mill chimneys smoking on the horizon.

books.title: चाँद का मुँह टेढ़ा है
books.author: गजानन माधव मुक्तिबोध
books.concept: A crooked, distorted moon over a surreal dark city of narrow lanes and factory chimneys at midnight, a shadowy procession passing, a lone figure with a lantern in an alley.

books.title: कविता के बहाने
books.author: कुँवर नारायण
books.concept: Paper birds folded from blank pages flying out of an open book into a sunny sky, a child chasing them, flowers blooming from the page edges.

books.title: नए इलाके में
books.author: अरुण कमल
books.palette: concrete grey, evening blue, warm streetlight
books.concept: A bewildered man at a crossroads in a fast-changing neighbourhood: half-built houses, scaffolding and cranes, while an old peepal tree and a remembered gate fade like smoke.

books.title: कलम का सिपाही
books.author: अमृत राय
books.palette: mahogany brown, lantern gold, teal shadow
books.concept: An old writing desk lit by a hurricane lantern: inkpot, dip pen, a stack of handwritten manuscripts and round wire spectacles; a village lane through the window.

books.title: खंजन नयन
books.author: अमृतलाल नागर
books.concept: A blind old poet singing with a one-stringed instrument on the Yamuna ghats at dawn, a pair of wagtails beside him, a flute and a peacock feather on the stone step.

books.title: देशद्रोही
books.author: यशपाल
books.concept: A lone man in a long coat on a 1940s railway platform at night, pamphlets under his arm, his shadow splitting in two directions, police lanterns approaching through steam.

books.title: अ ट्रैम्प अब्रॉड
books.author: मार्क ट्वेन
books.palette: alpine green, sky blue, red accents
books.concept: A humorous traveller with a walking stick and carpet-bag hiking in the Swiss Alps, a raft drifting down a German river below a castle, edelweiss in front.

books.title: अंग्रेज़ी उपन्यास और उसके विकास का सिद्धांत
books.author: सिडनी लेनियर
books.concept: An antique library desk with a tall stack of Victorian novels, a quill and an hourglass; loose pages spiral upward like a staircase toward a stained-glass window.

books.title: अंग्रेज़ी उपन्यास का विकास
books.author: विलबर एल. क्रॉस
books.concept: A tree growing out of an open antique book, its branches bearing tiny books like leaves and fruit, on parchment — the evolution of the novel.

books.title: अंग्रेज़ी छंद का विज्ञान
books.author: सिडनी लेनियर
books.concept: A violin and a quill crossing above flowing ribbons of abstract rhythm marks, a brass metronome and a lyre glowing softly — music and poetry meeting.

books.title: अंग्रेज़ी साहित्य का इतिहास
books.author: हिप्पोलाइट टेन
books.concept: A grand Gothic library hall with towering shelves receding into the past — manuscripts, folios, Victorian volumes — a beam of light from an arched window onto an open folio.

books.title: अपराध और प्रथा आदिम समाज में
books.author: ब्रोनिस्लाव मालिनोव्स्की
books.concept: A Trobriand outrigger canoe with a carved prow on a turquoise lagoon; shell necklaces and armbands on a woven mat in front; a palm-thatched village behind.

books.title: आज कत्ल हो के रहेगा
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A wall clock without numerals, hands nearing midnight, a revolver on a table under a lamp, a long ominous shadow on the door.

books.title: आस्तीन के सांप
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A cobra sliding out of the sleeve of a man in a crisp suit as he offers a friendly handshake.

books.title: इश्तिहारी मुजरिम
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A peeling poster with only a pencil-sketched face on a rain-soaked brick wall at night, a man in a raincoat walking away under a flickering street lamp.

books.title: कालगर्ल की हत्या
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A broken pearl necklace and a single red stiletto on the carpet of a dim hotel corridor, a door ajar with light spilling out, neon glow through blinds.

books.title: काला मोती
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A single lustrous black pearl in an open velvet jewellery box, reflected in a pool of spilled red wine, a gloved hand reaching from the shadows.

books.title: खतरनाक अपराधी
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A man in a trench coat silhouetted against prison searchlights, broken handcuffs dangling from one wrist, barbed wire on a high jail wall at night.

books.title: खतरनाक ब्लैकमेलर
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: Compromising photographs and film negatives spread on a desk, a gloved hand sealing an envelope with red wax, a telephone off the hook.

books.title: दौलत और खून
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: Gold coins spilling from an overturned chest across a marble floor, dark red drops mingling with the gold, a fallen crystal chandelier.

books.title: पुराने गुनाह नये गुनाहगार
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: An old sepia group photograph pinned to a dusty desk by a dagger, beside it a glowing modern mobile phone, cobwebs and a desk lamp.

books.title: पैंसठ लाख की डकैती
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A massive steel bank-vault door half open, bundles of banknotes spilling from canvas bags, a crowbar and gloved hands, a single swinging bulb.

books.title: बदसूरत चेहरे
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A cracked mirror reflecting several distorted shadowy faces, grotesque carnival masks hanging on the wall, a single bare bulb.

books.title: बैंक वैन रॉबरी
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: An armoured cash van on a rainy night highway with its rear doors blown open, smoke and banknotes swirling, headlights of a getaway car.

books.title: ब्लैकमेलर की हत्या
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A chalk outline on a parquet floor, photographs and negatives scattered around it, an empty safe hanging open, the shadow of a slowly turning ceiling fan.

books.title: मीना मर्डर केस
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A woman's portrait photograph in a broken frame on a rain-wet street, caught in a police flashlight beam, blue and red lights reflecting in puddles.

books.title: मूर्ति की चोरी
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: An empty stone pedestal in an ancient temple sanctum where a bronze idol once stood, a dust outline where it rested, a thief's rope dangling from a broken skylight.

books.title: मौत का खेल
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A chessboard under a hanging lamp where the pieces are bullets and the king is a small skull, a hand moving a bullet like a pawn.

books.title: रिपोर्टर की हत्या
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: An old typewriter with a bullet hole through a blank sheet, a press camera with a cracked lens, scattered blank pages under a desk lamp.

books.title: रेड सर्किल सोसाइटी
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: Hooded figures standing around a glowing red ring on the floor of a dark underground hall, candles flickering on stone walls.

books.title: विक्षिप्त हत्यारा
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A shattered window with spiderweb cracks, a glinting straight razor on the sill, a madman's silhouette on the staircase of a stormy old mansion.

books.title: शैतान की मौत
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A sinister horned mask shattered on a stone floor with a dagger through it, smoke curling up, a red sunset glowing through an old haveli window.

books.title: समुद्र में खून
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A luxury yacht on a dark moonlit sea, a red stain spreading through the water beside it, a lifebuoy floating, a lone figure at the rail.

books.title: हत्या की रात
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A rain-swept old haveli at night with one lit window; lightning reveals a silhouette with a raised knife behind the curtain.

books.title: हत्यारे
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: Three men in long coats holding guns under a railway bridge in thick fog, their shadows stretched long by a single street lamp.

books.title: हांगकांग में हंगामा
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: Hong Kong harbour at night with junk boats and glowing skyscrapers, a speedboat chase slicing through the water, sparks of gunfire.

books.title: होटल में खून
books.author: Surender Mohan Pathak
books.concept: A long retro hotel corridor with patterned carpet, a blank card hanging on a door handle, a dark red stain seeping from under the door, a brass room key on the floor.

books.title: अपने कत्ल की सुपारी
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A bundle of cash and a man's photograph with a red crosshair over the face on a table under a lamp, a pistol beside it; the same man watches through window blinds.

books.title: असली खिलाड़ी
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: Hands fanning playing cards that show only suit symbols over a green baize table, poker chips stacked, a pistol half hidden under a hat, cigar smoke.

books.title: एक मुट्ठी दर्द
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A rain-wet clenched fist holding a broken glass bangle and a crumpled photograph, a funeral pyre glowing in the night behind.

books.title: कलयुग की रामायण
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A giant ten-headed effigy burning on a modern city's Dussehra ground at night, fireworks overhead, a man with a pistol silhouetted against the flames.

books.title: कानून का बेटा
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A young man in police uniform holding his late father's old police cap and revolver, standing in the rain before a courthouse with the scales of justice above the gate.

books.title: कानून बदल डालो
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A wooden gavel smashing through a thick law book, pages bursting into the air, silhouettes of raised fists outside a courthouse.

books.title: केशव पंडित
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A man in a black lawyer's coat in a dark courtroom, a thick law book in one hand and a smoking pistol hidden behind his back, a spotlight on the empty judge's chair.

books.title: खलीफा
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A gangster boss's throne-like armchair in a smoky den, a heavy gold ring and a pistol on the armrest, shadows of men bowing before it.

books.title: चकमा
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A street con game: three brass cups on a small table, one lifted to reveal a bullet instead of a ball, quick sly hands blurred in motion.

books.title: तीन तिलंगे
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: Three men in silhouette walking abreast down a dusty street at sunset, coats flapping, one with a pistol, one with a chain, one with a hockey stick.

books.title: फांसी दो कानून को
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A hangman's noose swinging from a gallows with the scales of justice caught inside its loop, under a stormy sky.

books.title: वर्दी वाला गुंडा
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A police cap tilted on a table beside brass knuckles and a pistol, the shadow of a menacing policeman behind a frosted glass door.

books.title: विजय और विकास
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: Two young detectives back to back with pistols drawn in a dark warehouse, flashlight beams crossing through smoke between stacked crates.

books.title: सबसे बड़ी मर्डर मिस्ट्री
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A huge magnifying glass over a city map on a corkboard, red strings connecting pinned blank photographs, a fedora and a cup of tea on the desk.

books.title: हिंद का बेटा
books.author: Ved Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A lone soldier with a rifle on a snowy Himalayan ridge at sunrise, wind whipping snow, mountains glowing saffron.

books.title: इंसाफ का जनाजा
books.author: Ved Prakash Kamboj
books.concept: Shadowy men carrying a funeral bier through a night street; on it lie the scales of justice draped in white cloth, marigolds strewn on the road, torches flickering.

books.title: कदम कदम पर धोखा
books.author: Ved Prakash Kamboj
books.concept: A man in a hat walking across a chessboard-tiled floor whose tiles crack and fall away into darkness behind him, masks watching from the walls.

books.title: खतरे की खोपड़ी
books.author: Ved Prakash Kamboj
books.concept: A crystal skull glowing eerie green on an ancient altar in an overgrown jungle temple, explorers' flashlight beams cutting through mist.

books.title: प्रेतों का निर्माता
books.author: Ved Prakash Kamboj
books.concept: A mad scientist's laboratory with tall glass tubes holding ghostly figures, electric sparks arcing, a hunched man at a control panel.

books.title: रेलगाड़ी का भूत
books.author: Ved Prakash Kamboj
books.concept: A vintage steam train crossing an iron bridge at midnight, a ghostly translucent figure standing on a carriage roof, moonlight and fog.

books.title: एक रात का मेहमान
books.author: Om Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A mysterious stranger with a suitcase at the open door of a remote dak bungalow on a stormy night, a frightened caretaker holding up a lantern.

books.title: एक हसीना थी
books.author: Om Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A glamorous woman's silhouette in a red sari behind frosted glass, a smoking pistol on a dressing table among perfume bottles and a vanity mirror.

books.title: कब्रिस्तान का षड्यंत्र
books.author: Om Prakash Sharma
books.concept: A moonlit old graveyard with leaning tombstones, shadowy figures with lanterns digging an open grave, an owl on a dead tree.

books.title: केसरीगढ़ की काली रात
books.author: Om Prakash Sharma
books.concept: An old Rajasthani hill fort under a moonless black sky, torches moving along the ramparts, bats in the air, a dark rider galloping toward the gate.

books.title: विषकन्या
books.author: Om Prakash Sharma
books.concept: An ancient Indian woman's jewelled hand offering a goblet, a slim snake coiled around her wrist like a bangle, poisonous blue flowers around.

style: Approved reference look (the यशोधरा cover the user shared): a photorealistic film-still scene from the story (real skin, fabric and natural light, light film grain; it must not look AI-generated), a big gold-foil calligraphic Devanagari title (deep ink colour on light art), a thin rule with a lotus, the author in ivory, and an open-book icon with BOOKNOMICS at the foot. Every book gets its own theme colour (light, dark, blue, yellow, red, green, purple, ...).
